checklist: Every represented family has a concise family-character summary.
Every family has a 'where to look first' identification cue.
Every family has the strongest reproductive/morphological characters documented.
Every family has enough exact visual examples for those characters where available.
Each locally relevant family is compared against the most likely confusing local families.
